prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Animated Companion Showcase: Redesign the story screen into a centered spotlight view featuring animated companion showcases that highlight core pet behaviors.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:hero_pet_preview", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Meet your new desktop buddy", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to explicitly reassure returning users that logging into their account restores missing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign in to keep your pets synced", "body": "Log into your account to instantly restore your existing companions, items, and pet progress."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Split Comparison Layout: Rebuild the pick friend screen layout into a split comparison view featuring side-by-side choice cards and visual previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select your companion type", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_styles", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Controls Quick Reference on Waiting Screen: Display a quick reference carousel on the waiting screen explaining basic mouse clicks and shortcut commands for desktop pets.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open interaction controls and options.", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Spawn Checklist Guide on Home Intro: Transform the home intro screen into an interactive checklist flow that guides users through verifying their pet's desktop spawn.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Launch Your Pet onto the Desktop", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "1. Confirm pet appearance on desktop\n2. Try clicking pet\n3. Test right-click menu", "style": "plain"}]}}
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Customization Sound & Voice Selection Screen: Add a dedicated pet voice and sound selection screen prior to photo upload so users can pick companion audio traits.
   config: {"new_pet_sounds": {"headline": "Choose Companion Voice", "body": "Pick the sound effects and voice personality for your desktop companion.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "sound", "asset": "asset:pet_voice_options", "style": "playful"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_sounds", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [choose_path, hint] Quick Start Path Guidance Hint: Add an inline guidance hint explaining that pet traits and selected paths can be easily modified later in settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can change your path choices and pet personality at any time from the app settings."}}
7: [sign_in, layout] Centered Single-Column Sign In Layout: Change the sign-in screen to a centered single-column layout to reduce visual noise and simplify login.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered"}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Placement Troubleshooting Headline: Update the home intro headline and body with explicit troubleshooting steps if the pet does not automatically display on screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "body": "If your pet isn't visible right away, check your system tray menu or press Ctrl+Alt+P to show it."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Pet Voice Command Tips on Waiting Screen: Add interactive tips on the waiting screen demonstrating how to talk to and command the pet once it arrives on desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 8, "headline": "Initializing Pet Engine...", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Click the pet speech bubble or press Enter to start chatting with your companion.", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen while maintaining its job of introducing the pet.
Updates sign-in copy to reassure returning users without violating any pricing or fair design rules.
Redesigns the pick friend screen layout while preserving the core function of selecting a pet.
Adds desktop control tips to the waiting screen, which is permitted under rule 4.
Redesigns the home intro screen into an interactive checklist guide within onboarding limits.
Adds a new pet voice selection screen into onboarding while preserving all mandatory steps.
Adds an informational guidance hint to the choose path screen.
Simplifies sign-in layout without removing functionality or breaking onboarding rules.
Updates copy on the home intro screen to assist with desktop placement troubleshooting.
Adds voice command interaction tips to the waiting screen while keeping its initialization indicator.
